Model: Claude Opus 4.6
Audit fact type: pricing
Source-backed evidence: orate with a powerful model on complex tasks, Opus 5 is available on Claude for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users. For developers interested in building AI solutions that demand strong intelligence, Opus 5 is available on the Claude Platform natively, and in Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry. Pricing for Opus 5 starts at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, with up to 90% cost savings with prompt caching and 50% savings with batch processing. To learn more, check out our pricing page. To get started, use claude-opus-5 via the Claude API. For workloads that need to run in the US, US-only inference is available at 1.1x pricing for input and output tokens. Learn more.
